capabilities.title: Single-ended multilayer routing
capabilities.acceptance: Every selected connection is represented by legal quantized copper, connectivity is complete, and exact plus external KiCad DRC pass.
capabilities.gap: Dense-board global allocation and regional physical realization are not yet qualified.

capabilities.title: Route selection and protected-copper scope
capabilities.acceptance: Exact names, patterns, exclusions, classes, footprints, and declared groups expand deterministically while locked and unselected copper remain immutable.
capabilities.gap: Work-plan inspection, dry-run, and capability-gated execution expand exact names, simple globs, exclusions, net classes, footprints, and source-bound placement groups with selected/touching/internal scope, and expose exact removable versus immutable source copper. Route CLI parity beyond the initial work-plan adapter remains incomplete.

capabilities.title: Constraint-aware route ordering portfolios
capabilities.acceptance: Source order, explicit order, MPS, inside-out, scarcity, and bounded perturbed portfolios are reproducible and retain the best feasibility-first checkpoint.
capabilities.gap: MPS evidence exists experimentally; the complete public portfolio contract is not qualified.

capabilities.title: Conflict-directed rip-up and reroute
capabilities.acceptance: Attributed blockers drive bounded N+1 destruction, restored copper is preserved atomically, and repeated failures explore distinct corridors.
capabilities.gap: PathFinder history, blocker memory, and bounded LNS exist; explicit frontier/min-cut qualification remains incomplete.

capabilities.title: Future-demand and proximity guidance
capabilities.acceptance: Terminal survival, residual corridor demand, track spreading, vertical alignment, and guidance fields alter cost without authorizing illegal copper.
capabilities.gap: Terminal reservation and physical history are present; the complete typed field set is not exposed or qualified.

capabilities.title: Atomic differential-pair routing
capabilities.acceptance: Pair fanout, topology, polarity, vias, return path, gap, skew, curvature, and materialization are selected and accepted atomically.
capabilities.gap: Declared pair identity, shared capacity, synchronized transitions, and skew checks exist; complete topology and return-path behavior do not.

capabilities.title: Ordered bus routing
capabilities.acceptance: A reviewed ordered bus retains member order, adjacent spacing, synchronized transitions, and complete exact acceptance.
capabilities.gap: Explicit bus policy and advisory shared packing exist; proposal detection and complete joint realization remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Package-aware BGA and QFN fanout
capabilities.acceptance: Rotated BGA and QFN packages receive jointly packed, layer-aware, via-aware legal fanout that feeds the global route.
capabilities.gap: Flux has generic terminal access but no package-aware public fanout workflow.

capabilities.title: Power-aware trace routing
capabilities.acceptance: Reviewed current and fabrication policy drives explicit widths and legal transitions without weakening source DRC rules.
capabilities.gap: Net-class widths and bounded neck-downs exist; current policy and complete stepped transition validation are absent.

capabilities.title: Power-plane synthesis and repair
capabilities.acceptance: Proposed zones are refilled by KiCad, strictly re-imported, repaired from actual fill, and pass connectivity plus external DRC.
capabilities.gap: Saved fills and explicit unfilled-zone refill markers are modeled fail-closed, but Flux does not synthesize or repair planes.

capabilities.title: Return, stitching, and fence vias
capabilities.acceptance: Scarce transitions, existing same-net vias/PTHs, signal return vias, area stitching, and edge fences are selected with exact span and clearance checks.
capabilities.gap: Multisegment transitions and same-net via/PTH reuse exist; return-domain and stitching policy are absent.

capabilities.title: Length and propagation-time matching
capabilities.acceptance: Explicit groups meet physical length or propagation-time tolerances including vias, layers, pads, arcs, and coupled skew after materialization.
capabilities.gap: Narrow differential skew tuning exists; explicit groups and PH-native joint tuning do not.

capabilities.title: Stackup-aware impedance
capabilities.acceptance: Source-bound stackup and impedance targets produce applicable width/gap geometry and post-route reports with stated assumptions.
capabilities.gap: No impedance calculator or public impedance workflow exists.

capabilities.title: Router-in-the-loop placement
capabilities.acceptance: Every accepted placement passes hard intent constraints and a fresh complete global, regional, detailed, connectivity, and DRC transaction.
capabilities.gap: Integrated analytical and local placement are strong; full design-intent, portfolio, and package-repair workflows remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Source-bound design intent
capabilities.acceptance: A strict design brief compiles deterministically into reviewable source-bound placement policy and all hard constraints gate every move.
capabilities.gap: Groups, regions, relative constraints, and priorities exist; the unified design-brief schema and compiler do not.

capabilities.title: Logical target and polarity swaps
capabilities.acceptance: Explicitly permitted swaps produce reversible schematic and board change sets that require human approval and complete reroute validation.
capabilities.gap: Flux intentionally has no authoritative inferred swap behavior.

capabilities.title: Connectivity-preserving copper cleanup
capabilities.acceptance: Cleanup proposals create no new opens, shorts, or rule failures, preserve protected copper, and commit only as a complete improved transaction.
capabilities.gap: Route-local simplification exists; board-wide cleanup and repair vocabulary are absent.

capabilities.title: Board and routing diagnostics
capabilities.acceptance: Public diagnostics reuse authoritative routing predicates and emit stable machine-readable evidence plus inspectable overlays.
capabilities.gap: Core validation and PNG analysis exist; focused public diagnostic subcommands are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Pad and via teardrops
capabilities.acceptance: An explicit source-preserving teardrop policy is materialized using KiCad-compatible semantics and passes refill plus external DRC.
capabilities.gap: No teardrop policy or transaction exists.

capabilities.title: KiCad orchestration and application
capabilities.acceptance: The plugin snapshots the selected board, launches the same CLI work plan, supports cancellation, and applies only exact certified copper as one unsaved transaction.
capabilities.gap: File and live route application, strict KiCad 9 ordinal nets, strict KiCad 10 named nets and unfilled-zone markers, exact oval/offset pad drills, source-rule-context staging, and atomic publication after shell-free external KiCad JSON DRC exist; the full thin orchestration UI does not.

capabilities.title: Rendering, telemetry, and replay
capabilities.acceptance: Always-on observer telemetry, deterministic replay, static analysis images, and trace-derived movies cannot alter routing decisions or acceptance.
capabilities.gap: Live/history viewing and static PNG diagnostics exist; deterministic trace-to-video export is absent.

capabilities.title: Serializable plans and optional AI authorship
capabilities.acceptance: A versioned source-bound work plan dry-runs, preflights, serializes, replays deterministically, and treats optional AI as an untrusted author.
capabilities.gap: The source-bound typed schema, deterministic round trip, template, one-read policy verification/application, deterministic selector/protected-copper expansion, shared autoroute_v1 route-option compiler, inspection, and non-mutating capability preflight exist. The private-checkpoint executor supports generic route, declared differential-pair, declared ordered-bus, and validation steps with exact summaries, bounded fallbacks, stop tokens, policy/selector/step telemetry, and SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation, while the CLI refuses execution for partial manifest capabilities. Non-preview output is staged with source rule context and atomically published only after bounded shell-free external KiCad JSON DRC. Remaining fanout/plane/tuning/cleanup/placement adapters, deterministic replay, and optional untrusted AI authorship remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Progressive stress and release qualification
capabilities.acceptance: Qualified tiers remain permanently enabled, the frontier advances monotonically, artifacts are write-once, and release A/B waves record correctness plus performance evidence.
capabilities.gap: The progressive corpus and artifacts exist; not every tier or parity category is qualified.
